title: Network pharmacology analysis of the Huangqi-Gancao herb pair reveals quercetin as a therapeutics for allergic rhinitis via the RELA-regulated IFNG/IRF1 axis response.
authors: Deng, Yongjun; Shen, Limin; Zhu, Huilan; Zhou, Yanying; Hu, Xin
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究黄芪-甘草药对中槲皮素治疗过敏性鼻炎的机制，虽涉及分子对接但核心是药物靶点与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Despite the complexity of allergic rhinitis (AR) pathogenesis, no FDA-approved drug has been developed to achieve optimal therapeutic effects. The present study explored the efficacy and mechanism of Huangqi (Hedysarum Multijugum Maxim)-Gancao (Glycyrrhizae Radix et Rhizoma or licorice) herb pair in treating AR by network pharmacology and experimental approaches. The bioactive ingredients of Huangqi and Gancao were identified and used to predict the targets of these herbs in AR and generate the pharmacological network. Ovalbumin (OVA)-induced AR mouse model was established to assess the anti-AR effect of the Huangqi decoction (HQD) prepared based on both herbs. We identified 90 active ingredients of the Huangqi-Gancao pair, targeting 69 AR-related genes. Quercetin (QUE) was identified as the hub ingredient of this pair, with 57 targets in AR. The protein-protein interaction (PPI) network analysis and molecular docking revealed IL1B, TNF, STAT1, IL6, PTGS2, RELA, IL2, NFKBIA, IFNG, IL10, IL1A, IRF1, EGFR, and CXCL10 as important targets of QUE in AR treatment. Experimentally, QUE or HQD significantly alleviated the AR-induced histopathological changes, AR symptoms, and IgE level and counteracted AR-induced expression changes of IFNG, IRF1, RELA, and NFKBIA. These effects were promoted by the NF-kB inhibitor helenalin, indicating that HQD and QUE counteracted AR in mice by regulating the IFNG/IRF1 signaling via the NF-kappaB pathway in AR mice. These findings shed light on the efficacy of the constituents of Huangqi-Gancao pair, their potential targets, and the molecular mechanisms of HQD in treating AR, which could advance the development of tailored therapeutic interventions for this disorder.
abstract_zh: 尽管过敏性鼻炎（AR）发病机制复杂，目前尚无FDA批准的药物能达到理想治疗效果。本研究通过网络药理学和实验方法探讨了黄芪（Hedysarum Multijugum Maxim）-甘草（Glycyrrhizae Radix et Rhizoma或licorice）药对治疗AR的功效及机制。鉴定出黄芪和甘草的生物活性成分，用于预测这些草药在AR中的靶点并生成药理学网络。建立卵清蛋白（OVA）诱导的AR小鼠模型，以评估基于这两种草药制备的黄芪煎剂（HQD）的抗AR效果。我们鉴定出黄芪-甘草药对的90种活性成分，靶向69个AR相关基因。槲皮素（QUE）被确定为该药对的核心成分，在AR中有57个靶点。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络分析和分子对接揭示IL1B、TNF、STAT1、IL6、PTGS2、RELA、IL2、NFKBIA、IFNG、IL10、IL1A、IRF1、EGFR和CXCL10是QUE在AR治疗中的重要靶点。实验上，QUE或HQD显著缓解了AR诱导的组织病理学变化、AR症状和IgE水平，并抵消了AR诱导的IFNG、IRF1、RELA和NFKBIA表达变化。这些效应被NF-kB抑制剂海伦那林增强，表明HQD和QUE通过NF-kappaB通路调节IFNG/IRF1信号传导，从而在小鼠中对抗AR。这些发现揭示了黄芪-甘草药对成分的功效、其潜在靶点以及HQD治疗AR的分子机制，这可能推动针对该疾病的定制治疗干预措施的发展。
